failure_reason: Genuine Clearance PLPs were confirmed via site navigation and CMS metadata (all HTTP 200, real category pages), but exact product counts could not be verified for any row: the product grid is fetched client-side post-hydration (GraphQL/Constructor.io call requiring a browser-minted session token - not visible in server-rendered HTML); headless Playwright is hard-blocked by DataDome (403 on every attempt); Claude-in-Chrome (tier-3 last resort) was attempted but the shared browser session repeatedly lost its tab group between calls (foreign tabs from other concurrent workers appeared), so no page loads could be completed there for Clearance pages this session.
notes: Sale-vs-Clearance test: the site's OWN main-nav mega-menu (from homepage __NEXT_DATA__, props.pageProps.globalContent.headerV2.slideOutMenu.categoryMenu.menuItems) has a top-level menu item whose customer-facing label is literally 'Clearance' (content.text = 'Clearance'), with children labelled 'All Clearance', 'New to Sale', 'Sale Furniture', 'Sale Outdoor', 'Sale Bedding & Bath', 'Sale Rugs', 'Sale Lighting', 'Sale Pillows & Throws', 'Sale Decor & Entertaining', 'Sale Wallpaper', 'Sale Fabric', 'Sale Holiday'. Further corroboration: on the 'All Clearance' page itself (/category/sale-private-sale-1-shop-all, CMS-internal name 'All Sale'), the page's own on-site promotional banner copy reads 'Up to 40% off + hundreds of new adds to [clearance](/category/sale-private-sale-1-shop-all)' - the site uses 'clearance' as a common noun for this permanent markdown section in its own marketing copy, not just as a URL slug - and a distinct backend config key 'clearanceShippingDeliveryWhitelistSettings' exists, indicating Clearance is a persistent business/system concept, not a one-off promo. This satisfies the brief's taxonomy test (nav label + on-page copy), despite URL slugs and internal CMS names using 'sale-*'. Each child page was independently fetched (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124, HTTP 200) and its CMS category name confirmed to match a distinct, real listing (not an editorial/marketing page): sale-new-adds='New to Sale', sale-furniture='Furniture', sale-outdoor='Outdoor', sale-bedding-bath='Bedding & Bath', sale-rugs-windows='Rugs', decor-hardline='Lighting & Decor', sale-decor='Pillows & Throws', sale-tabletop-decor='Sale Tabletop and Decor', sale-wallpaper='Wallpaper ( sale-wallpaper )', sale-fabric='Fabric', sale-holiday='Holiday'. All are live, currently nav-linked, and use the same category-page template as verified working PLPs elsewhere on the site (e.g. the New Arrivals hub, where a product grid and count were directly observed) - so products being listed is inferred with high confidence though not visually re-confirmed per child page given access constraints. Excluded as orphaned/legacy: /category/sale (CMS name 'Sale', NOT linked from the current main nav or homepage - superseded by /category/sale-private-sale-1-shop-all) and /sale-landing (a non-/category/ landing page, not confirmed as a PLP). Also excluded as out-of-scope: /careers-outlet-manager-daytona (a retail-store job posting, not merchandising) and /category/fresh-wreaths-garlands-final-sale-messaging (a single product's final-sale messaging component found via sitemap keyword sweep, not a listing page). Checked via: full main-nav menu dump, full gzipped category sitemap keyword sweep (clearance|outlet|final-sale|last-chance|end-of-line), and direct fetch+CMS-metadata inspection of every candidate URL.
